important_instructions: Candidates must retain the acknowledgement/original certificates required for the post/category for which they are applying and produce them at the time of document verification. Candidates seeking rural, Kannada-medium, ex-serviceman, or other special reservation/relaxation benefits must submit the prescribed proof certificates in the specified formats by the last date of application submission. For more information, candidates may call the KEA helpdesk: 080-23460460 (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM). content_sections.heading: KEA Pharmacy Officer & Nursing Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: This notification covers vacancies reserved for the Kalyana-Karnataka cadre under Article 371(J) of the Constitution. Note: "Kre." posts are those to be filled following the local-candidate reservation points prescribed under Article 371(J). "Backlog" posts are vacancies left unfilled from a previous recruitment cycle. This second notification covers the remaining/general cadre vacancies in the Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Scheme's Medical Services Department. Combined total across both notifications: 233 posts (45 KK cadre + 188 General cadre).

content_sections.heading: KEA Pharmacy Officer & Nursing Officer Eligibility Criteria / Qualification
content_sections.text: The notification specifies that if a candidate is found not to meet the above qualification at any stage of the recruitment process — even after appearing for the examination — the application/candidature will be rejected. Candidate must be a citizen of India. A male candidate having more than one living spouse, and a female candidate who has married a man who already has a living spouse, are not eligible for appointment unless prior Government approval has been obtained. The candidate must be mentally and physically fit and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with efficient discharge of duties.

rows.post: Pharmacy Officer (ESI Scheme, Medical Services Department)
rows.qualification_required: Must possess a Diploma in Pharmacy from an institution recognized by the Government of Karnataka, and must be registered with the Karnataka Pharmacy Council.

rows.post: Nursing Officer / Shushrushadhikari (ESI Scheme, Medical Services Department)
rows.qualification_required: Must possess a Diploma in General Nursing issued by an authority authorized by the Government of Karnataka, and must be registered with the Karnataka Nursing Council.

rows.post: Nursing Officer / Shushrushadhikari (Karnataka Residential Educational Institutions Society – KK cadre only)
rows.qualification_required: Must have passed a B.Sc Nursing degree from a recognized university, with the institution recognized by the Indian Nursing Council/Karnataka State Nursing Council; OR must have passed PUC (or equivalent) and General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) from an institution recognized by the Indian Nursing Council/Karnataka State Nursing Council. In addition, the candidate must have studied Kannada as a language subject in a Postgraduate degree, Bachelor's degree, Pre-University course, SSLC, or Diploma, or must hold a Kannada certificate (Kavya/Jana/Rathna) conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board/Kannada Sahitya Parishat, Bangalore.

content_sections.heading: KEA Pharmacy Officer & Nursing Officer Age Limit
content_sections.text: As per the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977, the candidate must have completed a minimum of 18 years of age as on the last date fixed for submission of applications. Per Government Order No. ಸಿಆಸು 262 ಸೇನವಿ 2025 dated 29-01-2026, a one-time relaxation of 5 years has been added to the upper age limit; candidates must not exceed this relaxed upper age limit. Additional age relaxation (beyond the limits above) is available to specific categories as per the notification, including: Karnataka State Government/local authority/Central Government/undertaking employees (relaxation equal to years of service or 10 years, whichever is less), ex-servicemen, full-time NCC cadet instructors, Grameena Swayamsevaka Yojane volunteers, exceptionally talented candidates (10 years), persons belonging to Scheduled Tribes notified communities of Karnataka (as per service years or 5 years, whichever is less), widows (10 years), and retrenched permanent employees (10 years). Exact conditions for each category are listed in the original notification. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: KEA Pharmacy Officer & Nursing Officer Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a competitive examination conducted by KEA, either in Online (CBT) mode or Offline-OMR mode. The examination centre allotted will not be changed for any reason. Candidates who have studied Kannada as a first or second language subject in SSLC or a higher-level examination conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board or an equivalent examination recognized by the State Government, or who have passed a "Kadaya Kannada" test previously conducted by any authority for equivalent posts, are exempted from the Kannada Language Test. Other candidates must appear for the Kannada Language Test, which is objective type, carries 150 marks, and requires a minimum of 50 marks to qualify. Candidates who are absent or score below 50 marks in this test are disqualified. Marks scored in the Kannada Language Test are not counted towards merit or post allocation. Candidates must secure a minimum of 35% marks in the competitive examination to qualify. Candidates scoring below this will be declared unsuccessful. Each question in the competitive examination has 4 alternative answers, of which only one is correct. For every wrong answer, 0.25 marks (one-fourth of a mark) will be deducted. If a candidate shades more than one option for a question in the OMR answer sheet, and the discrepancy is not corrected before the end of the exam, 0.25 marks will be deducted for that question.

faq.question: Q1. What is KEA Pharmacy Officer & Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Karnataka Examinations Authority to fill Group-C posts of Pharmacy Officer and Nursing Officer across the ESI Scheme Medical Services Department and, under a separate Kalyana-Karnataka notification, allied departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 233 vacancies are notified - 188 under the RPC notification and 45 under the Kalyana-Karnataka notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application can be submitted until 30.08.2026, and the fee can be paid until 31.08.2026

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Diploma in Pharmacy registered with the Karnataka Pharmacy Council is required for Pharmacy Officer. A Diploma in General Nursing (or B.Sc Nursing/PUC+GNM for the KREIS post) registered with the Karnataka Nursing Council is required for Nursing Officer.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The general age limit is 18 to 40 years, with relaxation up to 43 years for Category 2A/2B/3A/3B and up to 45 years for SC/ST/Category-1 candidates, as of the last date of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹750 for general and other categories, ₹500 for SC/ST/Category-1/Ex-servicemen/Third gender, and ₹250 for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted only through the KEA official website, https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/, between 07.08.2026 and 30.08.2026.
